english: 41-43. The eight Aiśvaryas (Supernatural Powers) are these: Aṇimā (minuteness), Mahimā (greatness), Garimā (weightiness), Laghimā (lightness), Īśitva (ability to rule), Vaśitva (ability to control), Prāpti (ability to reach), Prākāmya (abundance). The eight powers are in the form of fiery elements. The adoration has been mentioned by the sages to be along with five Brahmas, Hṛllekha etc. as well as Umā and others, Indra and others constituting the ancillaries.
